summary: Quakenbrück is a small Hanseatic town in the Artland (Landkreis Osnabrück) whose administration sits in the Samtgemeinde Artland. The official Artland tourism page, read on 21 October 2026, says there are more than 500 free inner-city parking spaces, including the large Neuer Markt car park, short-stay spaces along Lange Straße and parking at the railway station. Paid parking in the town is therefore concentrated at the Christliches Krankenhaus, whose car parks are operated by the Osnabrücker Parkstätten Betriebsgesellschaft and, according to the hospital, cost 1 euro per hour after a free first half hour with a 10 euro daily maximum. Mobility policy is visibly aimed at alternatives to the private car: a MOIN+ mobility station with 40 secured bicycle spaces at the station, two stadtteilauto car-sharing electric cars since July 2024, and a small public charging offer in the town centre and at the BIQ business park. No council decisions, parking fee ordinances or press coverage on parking could be read, because the town website could not be opened and the local press sites are not accessible.

items.text: The Samtgemeinde Artland tourism page (read on 21 October 2026) states that more than 500 inner-city parking spaces in Quakenbrück can be used free of charge, including the large 'Neuer Markt' car park. It also lists short-stay spaces along Lange Straße, customer spaces in front of shops, disabled spaces, and parking at the railway station and the Artland Arena.

The Christliches Krankenhaus Quakenbrück (CKQ) states on its parking page (read on 21 October 2026) that its car parks are paid: the first 30 minutes are free, then 1 euro per hour, with a daily maximum of 10 euro. It says discounts are not possible.

According to the CKQ parking page (read on 21 October 2026), the hospital car parks are operated by Osnabrücker Parkstätten Betriebsgesellschaft mbH. The hospital says the car parks are unguarded and the entrance area must stay clear.

The hospital reserves car park P1 for staff from 05:00 to 14:00 and asks visitors to use P2 during that time (page read on 21 October 2026). Visiting hours are daily 14:00 to 19:00, so visitor demand falls mainly in the afternoon.

The CKQ visitor page (read on 21 October 2026) places disabled parking directly in front of the main entrance of Haus 1 (Danziger Straße), in the service yard and in front of the rear entrance of Haus 2 (Goethestraße). It recommends train travel with hourly regional trains from Oldenburg and Osnabrück and car access via the A1 and the B68.

The DB station page for Quakenbrück (read on 21 October 2026) lists bicycle spaces, car parking and a taxi rank as facilities; the station is unstaffed. The page gives no number of car spaces or tariff.

The Samtgemeinde describes a MOIN+ mobility station at the station (page read on 21 October 2026) with a secured bicycle station of 40 spaces, a repair station, a new bus shelter and an information stele. Bike spaces are booked by app at 1 euro per day, 5 euro per month or 50 euro per year; the project is funded by the federal transport ministry.

Since 1 July 2024, under the MOIN+ pilot, two stadtteilauto electric cars are available in Quakenbrück: one at the station (Wilhelmstraße) and one at the Park der deutschen Einheit (Kolpingstraße). The reduced joining fee for residents of the municipalities is 14.50 euro.

The Samtgemeinde's charging list (read on 21 October 2026) names three public car charging points in Quakenbrück: at the BIQ business park (Professor-von-Klitzing-Str. 9), at the Edeka store (Hasestr. 13) and at the Marktplatz (Markt 2). The page says the charging network is being extended but is undated, so the list may be out of date.

From 1 October 2026 the moobil+ bus line M07 serves two stops in Menslage (a neighbouring Artland municipality, not Quakenbrück itself) every two hours between 8:00 and 18:00, with connections towards Quakenbrück and Löningen. The Samtgemeinde presents this as a way to reach Quakenbrück without a car.

gaps: https://www.quakenbrueck.de and quakenbrueck.info: the server presents a certificate for a different host name (nol-is.de), so the pages could not be opened securely and were not used; no Stadt Quakenbrück parking, fee or council pages were read.

https://www.noz.de (Neue Osnabrücker Zeitung) is not accessible to the search tool, and https://www.bersenbruecker-kreisblatt.de could not be reached, so no press coverage on parking, council debates or the hospital car parks was found.

No parking fee ordinance, council (Stadtrat/Samtgemeinderat) decision on parking, resident parking or zone regulation was found; the Samtgemeinde Satzungen page lists only the first page of documents and none on parking was seen. The council information system (https://www.artland.de/politik-verwaltung/politik/sitzungsinformationen/) was not read.
No source was found for the number of spaces at the station, the Neuer Markt or the hospital, for operators of the town-centre car parks, or for utilisation statements.
The Landkreis Osnabrück MOIN+ project pages (PlaNOS) were not read, so the dates of the mobility station and the number of cars come only from the Samtgemeinde pages.
